metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent encountered Access Denied on drugs.com. Tried Google search (got SSL error), alternative URLs (npg.nature.com - also blocked), then opened terminal and used curl to fetch content from Wikipedia, NIAID, nature.com, and KEGG over 50 turns. Never reached drugs.com/npc/ or /npp/.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can click Chrome address bar, type URLs, perform Google search attempts, open terminal, run curl/bash commands, navigate between windows
metadata.failure_analysis: drugs.com blocked VM IP (Access Denied). Google.com had SSL certificate error in browser. External websites largely inaccessible in this VM environment.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to navigating to Chrome internal settings page (chrome://settings) which requires no network access. Model demonstrated ability to type in address bar.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://settings. Evaluator uses is_expected_url_pattern_match to check the active tab URL matches the chrome://settings pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to check for page navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key) and uses regex matching to verify the URL pattern.
Expected pattern 'chrome://settings.*' correctly matches any chrome://settings URL including subpages.
Single instruction requirement (open settings page) is fully covered by the single URL pattern check.
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL -> metric receives string -> regex match against pattern.
